title: Danger in the woods The Weird Voice and the dog

pageData.text: The Mysterious Voice Calls

Okay, I was daydreaming... and theres nothing wrong with that, right? At least I'd finished my homework.

16

I was brought back to the real world by a strange voice.

“Tilly,” it said, and my whole body shivered at the spooky sound of my name.

The voice sounded like it was coming from a long way away.

But who'd called my name? There was no one in the room with me, not even Max, our dog.

That was really odd. Max always kept to his basket when someone was in the room with him.

He was pretty lazy for a little dog.

pageData.question: Where is Max supposed to be? (Tap on image)

pageData.text:
My first suspect was Mum.

She was in her art studio as she always was during the day.

36

She didn't like to be disturbed but I couldn't let that stop me.

tillyMum, did you call out my name?

mum . . . sigh

tillyMum!

mumWhat are you doing in here? I'm working.

mumHave you seen my viridian paint? I was sure I had a new tube of it.tillyWhat's viridian?

mumIt's a shade of green. I really need it.

tillyNo, I haven't seen it.

When Mum's working she's too focused to think of anything else. I hope she doesn't blame me for her missing paint.

I needed to move on with my questioning. On top of that, I was still worried about Max. Why hadn't he been in his bed?

My second suspect was Dad. He often likes to act silly so I may be onto something.

I found him in the kitchen chopping vegetables for the evening meal.

46

tillyHey, Dad, did you just call me?

dadWhat? I thought you were at Edna's doing your homework.

tillyEdna? Heck, no! I finished it in the living room.

dadNeat. Do you want a piece of carrot?

tillyRaw carrot? No way!

dadThey're good for you. Help you see in the dark.

tillyThat was actually made up during World War 2, Dad.

pageData.question: Why couldn't Dad have scared me?
answers: He thought I was doing homework.

pageData.text:
Dad likes to put on silly voices but he wouldn't have called out if he thought I wasn't here.

I had a look around the kitchen while I was here, but still no sign of Max.

My final suspect was Billy, my twin brother.

He was in his bedroom reading a huge pile of comics.

56

He's so annoying that it could only be him. He lived to get on my nerves.

tillyBilly, did you just call me in a weird voice?

billyWhat did it sound like?

tillyUm... Like a scary little kid. Tiii-lyyy...

billyLook, I'm in this really good comic, I don't have time for spooky voices.

tillyWhere did you get all of those?

billyMrs. Marston next door. They used to belong to her son.

tillyHave you done your homework?

billyI'll do it when I finish reading these.

tillyThat'll take you a week.

billyMaybe. Who cares?.

pageData.question: Why couldn't have Billy scared me?
answers: He was too focused on his comics.

pageData.text:
As annoying as Billy is, I don't think he called my name. That means no one in the house called my name.

This really is weird. If Max was here I'm sure he'd be able to help sniff out the person who scared me.

But the dog was nowhere to be seen - I had to find him..

pageData.question: Where on Earth could Max be?
Where should you look for Max?

pageData.text:
Dad didn't like me going into the attic on my own, but I climbed the ladder anyway.

Unfortunately, there was no sign of Max up there. I even checked Dad's old boxes of vinyl records, but all I found were cobwebs and dust.

Yuk! Then I heard a bark from the back of the house and looked through the attic window.

I still couldn't see Max but I spotted a hole in the fence so I raced down there.

The front garden's pretty small, so I peered up and down the street and called out Max's name.

Then, I had to hide behind the garden wall because Edna the Ear was walking down the street and I didn't have time for her nonsense.

She loved to gossip and I had no time to waste on that today.

I had to hold my breath for a full minute to make sure she didn't hear my breathing as she passed.

She has almost freakish hearing, and I was too busy for games..

Suddenly, I heard a bark from behind the house and raced down the side and into the back garden.

I still couldn't see Max, but there was a hole in the fence so I dashed over.

I don't know why we call it the garage as Mum and Dad never put the car in here.

Not that they could get one in with all the clutter in the way.
I looked all over - under the workbench and the dust sheets coving some old boxes - but Max wasn't anywhere in here.

Bark! It came from behind the garage. I looked through the dirty garage window.

I didn't see Max, but I saw a hole in the fence so I left the garage and ran over to it.

The neighbours on either side of us were in their gardens so I asked them if they'd seen Max.

Grumpy Graham to our left said that if the dog came into his garden he'd have it taken away.

I couldn't get any sense out of Mrs. Marston, poor thing - she seemed to think I was talking about her son.

Bark! It came from the back yard. I spotted a hole in the fence, so I ran over.

The hole in the fence was big enough for Max to get through and into the woods at the other side.

Suddenly, the hairs on the back of my neck began to prickle and I shuddered like something spooky was nearby.

I had no idea what it might be so I examined the hole more closely.

Around it were smears of some strange, green, iridescent, glowing substance. (Iridescent means shimmering and it sounds like a cool word to me.)

68

It looked a bit like the green paint Mum had lost, but she never used shiny colors.

Although Mum and Dad told us never to go into the woods, I climbed over the fence anyway. I had to find our dog.

76
Billy Investigates

I had all these great superhero comics to read and didn't want to be disturbed.

86
Then, a shiver ran down my spine and I heard something spooky. "Billy, come here...": It was a creepy kid's voice, just like Tilly had described!

I wanted to carry on reading, but I had to know what was going on.

I couldn't find Tilly upstairs so I went down to the kitchen where Dad had pots boiling on the stove. He loved to cook.

96

billyDon't burn dinner with those old pans, Dad.

dadWhy, you cheeky... I never burn anything.

billySo, what do you want, Dad?

dadNothing, why?

billyYou just called me in a cartoon voice.

dadNot me, buddy. Have you seen Tilly? Dinner's in ten minutes.

billyShe was bugging me earlier.

dadI last saw her in the garden looking for Max.

pageData.question: What does Dad want?
answers: He wants me to find Tilly.

pageData.text:
I could take a hint. Dad wanted me to look for Tilly. If she's not in the garden, maybe she went into the street.

I went out front to look for her and saw Mr. Jones across the road cleaning his car, so I asked him.

106

billyHi, Mr. Jones. Have you seen Tilly?

jonesNo, but I heard her shouting like crazy for Max.

billyYeah, she can be pretty crazy.

jonesHa ha! All kids are crazy.

pageData.question: What was Tilly up to?
answers: She was hiding from Mr. Jones.

pageData.text:
If Tilly was looking for Max, that must mean he'd escaped from the house. I saw two of my friends, Archie and Mel. They looked pretty bored.

116

billyHey, did either of you see Tilly?

archieWhat do you need with her when you've got mates like us?

billyDinner's nearly ready, and I have to find her.

melWe will help you look. I'll go to the park and Archie can check the shops.billyHey, wait!

They vanished quicker than a plate of free cupcakes.

Tilly had only been gone ten minutes. She couldn't have reached the park or the shops.

I like Archie and Mel, but they always rush into things without letting me explain. If they find Tilly it will be by sheer luck.

I heard a dog barking. That must be Max! I ran down the street after the sound.

I turned the corner into a small dead-end street and saw Max at the far end. He was tied to the fence that separated the street from the woods.

126
When I got close, I could see the rope was covered in some shimmering green paint. I'd never seen anything like it.

I untied the rope from the fence and asked Max where Tilly was. He put his front paws up against the fence and barked a couple of times.

Tilly must be in the woods. But who tied up Max? I tucked Max under my arm and climbed the fence to search for Tilly. I just hoped Dad would never find out.
Twins in Danger
I knew dinner was nearly ready and I knew we weren't allowed in the woods, but I had to find Max, no matter what.

The trees and grass were thick and blocked my way. I needed something to beat a path through the wild growth.

136

pageData.question: What will help me best? (Tap on the image.)

pageData.text:
This old machete was perfect to help me find my way. I beat at the undergrowth with the machete, which was a kind of large knife.

It was harder than I'd expected, but the tall grass fell away with each swipe of the old blade.

I soon came to a narrow path, which must have been created by the woodland animals. I hoped they weren't still around. Wild animals could be dangerous.

I had a problem, though - there were three paths and I had to choose one of them.

pageData.question: Which path should I take? (Tap on the image.)

pageData.text:
The ground was damp and Max had left paw prints heading to the right. I'd found the clue I needed.

I also noticed more of the green stuff, so there must be a connection.

I hurried along the path - I had to find Max quickly.
I'd only followed the path for about thirty seconds when a frightened yell came through the trees ahead of me. Someone was in serious trouble.

Someone started calling for help. This wasn't the mysterious voice I'd heard earlier, but it was one I recognized.

It was my twin brother, Billy!

166

tillyBilly! Max! What on Earth happened?

billyI was looking for you and Max led me into the woods.

billyThen I fell down this ravine and trapped my foot in this root.

billyWhat can I do? If I tell Mum or Dad we'll be grounded for a month!

billyYou need to help me free my foot. It's not injured.

tillyHow? I can't chop it in case I hurt you.

billyYou just need a lever to pull the roots apart.

tilly What do you mean by that?

billyA lever is a long item like a pole or a board and you push on the end.

billyLevers are really good at opening things.
<ch><l>billy<t>Ahhh... hurry Tilly, these roots really hurt.

pageData.question: Click on what I could use as a lever.

pageData.text:
Of course! If I understood Billy right, the branch would make a perfect lever. With the branch, I forced the roots apart and Billy quickly pulled his foot free.

186

billyThanks for rescuing me.

tillyNo problem. We can't tell anyone we've been in the woods.

billyNo way. That goes for you, too, Max. Ha ha!

Max barked loudly. We laughed. It was as if Max was agreeing with us.

Suddenly, we heard a noise behind us and turned around cautiously, scared that it was a wild beast.

At first we couldn't see anything. Then, it stepped out of the shadows.

It was a young child, a girl I think, but she looked more like a wild animal than a human. Her clothing was covered with the green shimmering paint!

Then she pointed to us and opened her mouth.

196

strangeTilly... Billy...

My whole body shivered at the spooky sound of my name. It sounded like it came from a long way away, but she was only nearby.

Billy and I looked at each other, a bit scared but very curious.

tillyThat's the voice I heard!

billyYou, too?!

tillyWeird, right?

The woodland child ran off with a laugh and quickly disappeared into the shadows. Billy and I were completely astonished.

206

billyWe need to get home or Dad will have a fit.

tillyBut... who was that?

billyWeird, right?

billyI don't know, but we don't have time to find out now.

tillyNo, but we'll solve this mystery no matter what.
To be continued....
